faqs.q: Sec. 102-207. - Determination of amount of use.
faqs.a:
(a)
The amount of sewage/wastewater discharged from the connected user to the city sewer
               system will be determined by the average of the bimonthly amount of water metered
               to the user during any four-month period between November 1 and April 30 in each 12-month
               period. With the exception that commercial swimming pools and supporting facilities,
               where the second water meter was installed in accordance with
section 102-61
(k)(2) and (3), the amount of sewage/wastewater discharged from the swimming pool
               and supporting facilities to the city sewer system will be determined by the average
               of the bimonthly amount of water metered through the second meter to the user in a
               12-month period from July to July of each year.
(b)
When brought to the attention of the finance director, the finance director will make
               an investigation of the facts and conditions applicable to the connected user when
               any one of the following situations occurs:
(1)
The amount of metered water during the above-stated period does not reasonably determine
               the amount of sewage/wastewater discharged to the sewer system;
(2)
The circumstances of the connected user change after the above-stated period so that
               the amount of metered water during the above-stated period no longer reasonably determines
               the amount of sewage/wastewater discharged to the sewer system by the user; or
(3)
The user does not have a water meter.
The finance director will then make a determination as to the amount of sewage/wastewater
               discharged by the user to the sewer system based on the conditions found to exist
               so that the sewer service charge will be just, fair and equitable.
(c)
The amount of sewage/wastewater so determined to be discharged by the user to the
               sewer system will then be the basis for computing the bimonthly sewer service charge
               to the user.
(d)
If a connected user's property has a swimming pool used all year and the pool is connected
               to the city sewer system, then the amount of sewage/wastewater discharged from the
               connected user to the city sewer system will be determined by the average of the bimonthly
               amount of water metered to the user during the full year. In this instance, the connected
               user may meter irrigation water use through a separate meter installed as approved
               by the director of utilities.
(e)
If the connected user's property has a swimming pool connected to the city sewer system,
               and that connected user is billed for only part of a year, then the amount of sewage/wastewater
               discharged from the connected user to the city sewer system will be determined by
               the average amount of water metered to the user during as many months as the user
               is billed.
(Code 1981, § 33-111; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 2671, § 37, 10-16-1989;
               Ord. No. 2763, § 21, 11-5-1990; Ord. No. 2823, § 13, 7-1-1991)
